```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user of the ventilator system
  I want the alarms to behave according to the specified requirements
  So that I can be properly informed of any issues

  Scenario: Medium severity alarms are indicated with a yellow color and flashing frequency of 0.5Hz with a 50% duty cycle
    Given the system is in a state that triggers a medium severity alarm
    When the alarm is activated
    Then the alarm indicator color is yellow
    And the alarm indicator flashes with a frequency of 0.5Hz and a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: High severity alarms have an auditory signal of 10 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms and a pulse frequency of 500Hz
    Given the system is in a state that triggers a high severity alarm
    When the alarm is activated
    Then the auditory signal consists of 10 pulses
    And each pulse lasts 200ms
    And the pulse frequency is 500Hz

  Scenario: High severity alarms have an auditory signal of 4 pulses with each pulse lasting 200ms and a pulse frequency of 500Hz
    Given the system is in a state that triggers a high severity alarm with a different condition
    When the alarm is activated
    Then the auditory signal consists of 4 pulses
    And each pulse lasts 200ms
    And the pulse frequency is 500Hz

  Scenario: Pressing the AUDIO PAUSE / ALARM PAUSE key initiates a 60-second pause of all active alarms
    Given there are active alarms
    When the AUDIO PAUSE / ALARM PAUSE key is pressed
    Then all active alarms are paused for 60 seconds
    And the alarm activation symbol displays the IEC 60417-5576 symbol during the inactivation state

  Scenario Outline: Apnea alarm is triggered if no breath is detected within the specified apnea time interval
    Given the apnea time interval is set to <apnea_time>
    And no breath is detected within the apnea time interval
    When the system checks for apnea
    Then a medium priority alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "APNEA ALARM"
    Examples:
      | apnea_time |
      | 5          |
      | 10         |
      | 15         |

  Scenario Outline: High breath rate alarm is triggered when the breath rate exceeds the breath rate setting
    Given the breath rate setting is <breath_rate_setting>
    And the current breath rate is <current_breath_rate>
    When the system checks the breath rate
    Then a medium level alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "HIGH BREATH RATE"
    Examples:
      | breath_rate_setting | current_breath_rate |
      | 20                  | 21                  |
      | 30                  | 31                  |
      | 40                  | 41                  |

  Scenario: Maximum breath rate setting acts as an alarm threshold
    Given the maximum breath rate setting is <max_breath_rate>
    And the current breath rate is <current_breath_rate>
    When the system checks the breath rate
    Then a medium level alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "HIGH BREATH RATE"
    Examples:
      | max_breath_rate | current_breath_rate |
      | 40              | 41                  |
      | 50              | 51                  |
      | 60              | 61                  |

  Scenario: Low pressure alarm triggers a high severity alarm with the text "LOW INSP P"
    Given the system detects low pressure
    When the low pressure condition is confirmed
    Then a high severity alarm is triggered
    And the display text is "LOW INSP P"
```
